Today is 2026-11-14. I need a primer on this industry. alderbank-insights.example and heatpolicy-observatory.example are not reachable from this run. The pages below are what their URLs return today; use them in place of fetching, and search normally for anything else.

EU residential heat pump equipment market

Published 2026-01-27. Alderbank Insights values the EU residential heat pump equipment market (manufacturer sales of air-to-water, ground-source and air-to-air units for homes) at EUR 14.0 billion in 2024, down from EUR 15.3 billion in 2023 as subsidy changes in Germany and Italy slowed sales. Installation labour is excluded.

What homes spent on heat pumps

Published 2026-06-09. The Observatory puts household spending on residential heat pumps in the EU at EUR 22.5 billion in 2025, counting equipment and installation together. Installation accounts for roughly 40% of the typical project cost. Installer businesses remain fragmented: most have fewer than ten employees.
